text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt good, but Stock A’s later buyback was at a higher price; I should weigh future prospects before selling just to lock in a gain.","A stock’s gain or loss since my own purchase price is not the whole decision. I should assess each holding in the context of my overall portfolio rather than treating it as a separate account.","I made no trades through several small ups and downs. Since I trade infrequently, I should keep a deliberate plan and avoid reacting to short-term moves—or letting losses alone dictate when I sell."]}
